proposals.translation:
그렇다, 지금 록맨이
유니존 가능한 소울은
거츠 소울이지
proposals.rationale: Preserve current Rockman, possible soul-unison and Guts Soul identification. 유니존 가능한 expresses 유니존できる without changing the mechanic. Three source lines retained; original draft remains unmodified.

proposals.translation:
즉 「크랙아웃」 등
지형 파괴 칩을 바쳐
유니존할 수 있다
proposals.rationale: Preserve CrackOut as an example, terrain-destruction chip category, offering a chip and the resulting unison possibility. Reassign the Korean clauses within the same three source lines; no command/token/term or gameplay implementation is changed. This legacy script's presence does not prove a supported EXE4.5 mechanic.
